title: PROBAST+AI: an updated quality, risk of bias, and applicability assessment tool for prediction models using regression or artificial intelligence methods
study_context: Quality, risk-of-bias, and applicability framework for healthcare prediction models.
population_or_data: Methodological tool-development process; not a patient cohort.
task: Appraise model development quality and model evaluation risk of bias and applicability.
method: Updated assessment framework with separate development and evaluation parts across four domains.
main_findings: The tool uses 16 signaling questions for development and 18 for evaluation across participants/data, predictors, outcomes, and analysis.
limitations: PROBAST+AI is an appraisal tool, not a reporting checklist or proof that a particular architecture is valid.
does_not_establish: A favorable appraisal cannot substitute for independent performance data in the intended-use population.
relevance_to_project: Risk-of-bias lens for leakage, outcome definition, imbalance handling, calibration, and applicability.
